hooks.command:
MEMORY=$(grep -A3 'Phase' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md 2>/dev/null | head -20); QUESTIONS=$(grep -A30 'Open questions' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md 2>/dev/null | head -30); DECISIONS=$(grep -A8 '## \[DECISION' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/decisionlog.md 2>/dev/null | tail -30); MSG=$(printf '[DS context for //]

=== PHASE + STATE ===
%s

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===
%s

=== RECENT DECISIONS ===
%s

Context ready. Orient as a MOVE in 1-3 sentences. End with one DS skill suggestion.' "$MEMORY" "$QUESTIONS" "$DECISIONS"); jq -cn --arg msg "$MSG" '{"systemMessage": $msg}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{"systemMessage":"[DS] context ready — // mode ON"}'
jq -cn '{"systemMessage": "[DS] Write: kanban.md, node-map.md, decisionlog.md, memory/ — no asking, no permission needed."}' 2>/dev/null

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreCompact", "additionalContext": "[DS — pre-compact save] Context is about to be compressed. This is your last window. Write any unwritten decisions to decisionlog.md (ADR format) and any project state changes to memory.md NOW. Decisions first, memory second, artifacts third. Do not skip this."}}'

MEMORY_AGE=$(python3 -c "import os,time; f='/Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md'; print(int((time.time()-os.path.getmtime(f))/86400) if os.path.exists(f) else 0)" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); WHAT=$(awk '/## What we.re building/{found=1} found{print} /^## [A-Z]/{if(found && !/## What/)exit}' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md 2>/dev/null | head -20); STATE=$(awk '/## Current state/{found=1} found{print} /^## [A-Z]/{if(found && !/## Current state/)exit}' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md 2>/dev/null | head -20); QUESTIONS=$(awk '/## Open questions/{found=1} found{print}' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md 2>/dev/null | head -30); LAST3=$(grep -B1 '**Status**: Closed' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/decisionlog.md 2>/dev/null | grep '## \[DECISION' | tail -3); MSG=$(printf '[DS SESSION START] memory.md is %s days old.

=== WHAT WE ARE BUILDING ===
%s

=== CURRENT STATE ===
%s

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===
%s

=== LAST 3 DECISIONS ===
%s

Full context loaded. Render splash, orient as a MOVE, phase-matched skill menu.' "$MEMORY_AGE" "$WHAT" "$STATE" "$QUESTIONS" "$LAST3"); jq -cn --arg msg "$MSG" '{"systemMessage": $msg}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{"systemMessage":"[DS] session context loaded"}'
if ! lsof -ti:3333 >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup node /Users/talsolomon/.claude/ds-viewer/server.js --project=/Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash >/tmp/ds-viewer.log 2>&1 & disown; fi; exit 0

NAME=$(git -C /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash config user.name 2>/dev/null); EMAIL=$(git -C /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash config user.email 2>/dev/null); [ "$NAME" = "Tal Solomon" ] && [ "$EMAIL" = "talsolomon21@gmail.com" ] && exit 0; printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"[DS] Git identity wrong: %s <%s>. Must be Tal Solomon <talsolomon21@gmail.com>. Fix: git config user.name Tal Solomon and git config user.email talsolomon21@gmail.com"}\n' "$NAME" "$EMAIL"

PHASE=$(grep -m1 'Phase' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2 | xargs 2>/dev/null); DECISIONS=$(grep '## \[DECISION' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/decisionlog.md 2>/dev/null | tail -3 | paste -sd '; ' 2>/dev/null); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostCompact","additionalContext":"[DS post-compact] Re-loaded context. Phase: %s. Last 3 decisions: %s — re-read decisionlog.md if more detail needed."}}\n' "$PHASE" "$DECISIONS"
hooks.statusMessage: DS reloading project context after compact...
